hero.title: International Conference on Digital Investment and the Transition to Smart Digitalization
hero.theme: Under the theme: Towards an integrated economic environment led by innovation and artificial intelligence

about.title: A strategic meeting for digital investment leaders
about.description: A conference that brings together decision-makers, experts, and entrepreneurs to discuss the future of digital investment and the transition to smart digitalization, build strategic partnerships, leverage emerging technologies, accelerate digital transformation, and enhance national economies’ readiness to integrate into the smart global economy.

objectives.title: Ten priorities shaping the digital investment agenda
items: Highlighting the role of digital investment as a key pillar for building a competitive economy driven by innovation and technology.
Stimulating major investment flows toward technology projects, digital platforms, and the sharing economy.
Formulating a unified digitalization framework that strengthens economic integration and raises countries’ readiness for the global smart economy.
Creating a competitive digital business environment that supports startups, attracts investors, and accelerates digital expansion.
Discussing legal regulations and policies that support the digital economy and foster a safe innovation and investment climate.
Empowering government digital transformation through smart strategies that redesign services and improve efficiency.
Strengthening digital trust by developing cybersecurity frameworks, protecting data, and supporting good governance.
Advancing the sharing economy to become a major growth contributor through legislation development and innovative platforms.
Turning digitalization into an effective economic engine that creates new jobs, raises productivity, and stimulates innovation.
Launching joint initiatives that contribute to building a unified and robust digital infrastructure.

participants.title: Who will join the conference
items: Decision-makers and government officials in the fields of economy, digitalization, investment, trade, industry, and services.
Local and international investors, investment funds, venture capital, investment agencies and offices, financial markets, and multi-commodity markets.
Technology companies, telecommunications and information firms, and digital and innovation institutions.
Entrepreneurs and startups in technology and digital sectors, incubators, and free zones.
Experts and researchers in digital green economy, technology policies, and renewable energy.
Financial and banking institutions interested in digital transformation, smart services, insurance companies, and financial services institutions.
Regional and international organizations concerned with digital transformation and economic development, universities, technical colleges, and higher education institutions.
Private sector entities of all kinds seeking to develop their digital operations from companies, authorities, and institutions.

program.title: Conference Program
program.description: Explore the full agenda of sessions, axes, and the round table.

sessions.title: Session 1: Digital investment and technological innovation
axes: The role of digital investment in building an advanced competitive economy.
The future of investments in emerging technologies such as AI, blockchain, and cloud computing.
Global shifts in venture capital and opportunities to attract investment to the Arab region.
Mechanisms to accelerate investment flows into large technology projects.

sessions.title: Session 2: Digital integration and a unified digitalization framework
axes: A strategy for unifying digital systems and standards in Arab countries.
The role of digital integration in strengthening institutional competitiveness.
Digitalization as a key driver of productivity and sustainable growth.
The future of the sharing economy as a core contributor to economic growth.

sessions.title: Session 3: Building the digital business environment and empowering startups
axes: Building a competitive business environment based on innovation and digitalization.
Supporting startups and incubators through innovative digital solutions.
Digital transformation as a key factor in raising the quality of advanced digital services.
New partnership models between the public and private sectors to support the digital economy.

sessions.title: Session 4: Government digital transformation and smart public services
axes: Smart digital transformation strategies in the public sector.
Developing smart services supported by systems and big data.
Improving government efficiency through digitalization and AI technologies.
The role of legal regulations in building a strong and unified digital environment.

sessions.title: Session 5: Legal regulations and supportive policies
axes: Reviewing and updating legal frameworks to facilitate digital investment.
Policies to stimulate innovation and digital entrepreneurship in support of the national economy.
Developing legislation for the sharing economy and cross-border platforms.
Legal controls governing investment systems in free and technology zones.

sessions.title: Session 6: Cybersecurity and digital trust
axes: Ensuring data security in the era of the digital economy.
Developing policies to reduce cyber risks.
Digital connectivity, open partnerships, and shared cloud computing.
Enhancing public trust in digital services and transactions.
